import Mathlib.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.Lattice
import Mathlib.Order.Atoms

/-! The algebraic argument of Acuaviva--Kania, Primariness and the Primary
Factorisation Property, Proposition `prop:maximal-ideal-pfp` (Section 2).
Nontriviality is essential: in the zero ring the nonfactorisation set is empty.
The proof follows the source's compression/additivity/largest-ideal argument.
-/
namespace ThesisCommon
namespace FactorizationRing
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Single-product factorisation of the identity, rather than membership in
the two-sided ideal generated by `t`. -/
def FactorsOne (t : R) : Prop := ∃ a b : R, a * t * b = 1

def HasDichotomy (R : Type*) [Ring R] : Prop :=
  ∀ t : R, FactorsOne t ∨ FactorsOne (1 - t)

theorem factorsOne_one : FactorsOne (1 : R) := ⟨1, 1, by simp⟩

theorem FactorsOne.of_compression {t : R} (a b : R)
    (h : FactorsOne (a * t * b)) : FactorsOne t := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨u * a, b * v, by simpa only [mul_assoc] using h⟩

theorem not_factorsOne_zero [Nontrivial R] : ¬ FactorsOne (0 : R) := by
  rintro ⟨a, b, h⟩
  simp at h

/-- The key additive step: compress S+T to 1 and apply the dichotomy to ASB. -/
theorem nonfactor_add (h : HasDichotomy R) {s t : R}
    (hs : ¬ FactorsOne s) (ht : ¬ FactorsOne t) : ¬ FactorsOne (s + t) := by
  rintro ⟨a, b, hab⟩
  have heq : 1 - a * s * b = a * t * b := by
    rw [← hab, mul_add, add_mul, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rcases h (a * s * b) with hS | hT
  · exact hs (hS.of_compression a b)
  · rw [heq] at hT
    exact ht (hT.of_compression a b)

/-- The genuine two-sided ideal whose carrier consists of nonfactorising
elements; no ideal property is assumed as an input. -/
def nonfactorIdeal [Nontrivial R] (h : HasDichotomy R) : TwoSidedIdeal R :=
  .mk' {t | ¬ FactorsOne t}
    not_factorsOne_zero
    (nonfactor_add h)
    (by
      intro t ht hn
      apply ht
      have heq : (-1 : R) * t * 1 = -t := by simp
      rw [← heq] at hn
      exact hn.of_compression (-1) 1)
    (by
      intro a t ht hn
      apply ht
      have hn' : FactorsOne (a * t * 1) := by simpa using hn
      exact hn'.of_compression a 1)
    (by
      intro t b ht hn
      apply ht
      have hn' : FactorsOne (1 * t * b) := by simpa using hn
      exact hn'.of_compression 1 b)

@[simp] theorem mem_nonfactorIdeal [Nontrivial R] (h : HasDichotomy R) (t : R) :
    t ∈ nonfactorIdeal h ↔ ¬ FactorsOne t := by
  simp [nonfactorIdeal]

theorem nonfactorIdeal_ne_top [Nontrivial R] (h : HasDichotomy R) :
    nonfactorIdeal h ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro heq
  have h1 := (TwoSidedIdeal.one_mem_iff (nonfactorIdeal h)).mpr heq
  exact (mem_nonfactorIdeal h 1).mp h1 factorsOne_one

/-- Every proper two-sided ideal is contained in the nonfactorisation set. -/
theorem proper_ideal_nonfactor {J : TwoSidedIdeal R} (hJ : J ≠ ⊤)
    {t : R} (ht : t ∈ J) : ¬ FactorsOne t := by
  rintro ⟨a, b, hab⟩
  have h1 := J.mul_mem_right (a * t) b (J.mul_mem_left a t ht)
  rw [hab] at h1
  exact hJ ((TwoSidedIdeal.one_mem_iff J).mp h1)

theorem nonfactorIdeal_largest [Nontrivial R] (h : HasDichotomy R)
    {J : TwoSidedIdeal R} (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) : J ≤ nonfactorIdeal h := by
  intro t ht
  exact (mem_nonfactorIdeal h t).mpr (proper_ideal_nonfactor hJ ht)

theorem nonfactorIdeal_isCoatom [Nontrivial R] (h : HasDichotomy R) :
    IsCoatom (nonfactorIdeal h) := by
  refine ⟨nonfactorIdeal_ne_top h, ?_⟩
  intro J hlt
  by_contra hJ
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) (nonfactorIdeal_largest h hJ)

theorem nonfactorIdeal_unique [Nontrivial R] (h : HasDichotomy R)
    {J : TwoSidedIdeal R} (hJ : IsCoatom J) : J = nonfactorIdeal h := by
  have hle := nonfactorIdeal_largest h hJ.1
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
  · exact False.elim (nonfactorIdeal_ne_top h (hJ.2 _ hlt))
  · exact heq

/-- Merely being an ideal already forces the dichotomy. -/
theorem dichotomy_of_nonfactor_ideal (J : TwoSidedIdeal R)
    (hJ : ∀ t, t ∈ J ↔ ¬ FactorsOne t) : HasDichotomy R := by
  classical
  intro t
  by_cases ht : FactorsOne t
  · exact Or.inl ht
  · right
    by_contra hnt
    have h1 := J.add_mem ((hJ t).mpr ht) ((hJ (1 - t)).mpr hnt)
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at h1
    exact (hJ 1).mp h1 factorsOne_one

theorem dichotomy_iff_maximal_nonfactor [Nontrivial R] :
    HasDichotomy R ↔ ∃ J : TwoSidedIdeal R,
      (∀ t, t ∈ J ↔ ¬ FactorsOne t) ∧ IsCoatom J := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨nonfactorIdeal h, mem_nonfactorIdeal h, nonfactorIdeal_isCoatom h⟩
  · rintro ⟨J, hJ, _⟩
    exact dichotomy_of_nonfactor_ideal J hJ

end FactorizationRing
end ThesisCommon
